max-height.desc: The maximum height of the Tooltip; Size in CSS units, including unit name

max-width.desc: The maximum width of the Tooltip; Size in CSS units, including unit name

anchor.desc: Two values setting the starting position or anchor point of the Tooltip relative to its target

self.desc: Two values setting the Tooltip's own position relative to its target

offset.desc: An array of two numbers (in pixels) which expands the anchor element's bounding box outward horizontally and vertically; the Tooltip is then positioned against the expanded box, so the visible effect depends on the 'anchor'/'self' points in use

scroll-target.desc: CSS selector or DOM element to be used as a custom scroll container instead of the auto detected one; Only used by the JS positioning fallback of browsers without CSS anchor positioning support (on the others the Tooltip tracks its target natively instead of hiding on scroll, with no listeners)

delay.desc: Configure Tooltip to appear with delay

hide-delay.desc: Configure Tooltip to disappear with delay

persistent.desc: Prevents Tooltip from auto-closing when app's route changes

updatePosition.desc: On browsers with CSS anchor positioning support the browser keeps the Tooltip positioned against its target automatically and this method only re-checks whether the intended placement still fits the viewport; on the JS positioning fallback of other browsers it recomputes the position for the custom scenarios which Quasar cannot detect without significant performance drawbacks
